scripts.setup: npm run composer:init && npm run mkdirs && npm run copy-fonts
scripts.mkdirs: for a in src/*/Public/assets; do mkdir -p "$a/dist/webfonts" "$a/dist/css" "$a/dist/js"; done
scripts.copy-fonts: for a in src/*/Public/assets; do mkdir -p "$a/dist/webfonts"; cp -r node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/* "$a/dist/webfonts/"; done
scripts.build: npm run copy-fonts && npm run css:build && npm run js:build
scripts.build:dev: npm run copy-fonts && npm run css:build && npm run js:build:dev
scripts.js:build: npm run typecheck && rspack build --mode production
scripts.js:build:dev: npm run typecheck && rspack build --mode development
scripts.typecheck: for c in src/*/tsconfig.json; do [ -f "$c" ] || continue; echo "typecheck ${c%/tsconfig.json}"; tsc --noEmit -p "$c" || exit 1; done
scripts.css:build: for f in src/*/Public/assets/src/index.scss; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; sass --style=compressed --load-path=node_modules --source-map-urls=relative "$f" "${f%/src/index.scss}/dist/css/index.css"; done
